ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: The smell of rain on dry ground brings back an elder's memories of a hut that no longer stands.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A storm is coming in off the sea, and the air fills with that heavy, earthy smell of rain on dry ground. For (subject) it brings back, all at once, a hut that no longer stands, a voice (subject.he/she) hasn't heard in many years, and a warm bowl of soup on a stormy night long ago.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) describes the old hut, the soup, the voice. (friend) listens to every word. "I wish I'd known them," (friend.he/she) says. "So do I," says (subject). "You'd have liked each other." They sit and watch the rain come in together.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) stands in the doorway with (subject.his/her) eyes closed while the first drops fall. For a moment (subject.he/she) is very young and very old at the same time. Then the rain gets heavier, and (subject.he/she) goes inside to make soup.
